title: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 4

blocks.source_text: With 26.4 Snapshot 4, we're breaking out a cool new block, introducing Brittle Ice! And Jukeboxes can now keep the music going with playlists by putting your music discs in a chest above them, making dance parties much easier. Just be careful not to dance on the Brittle Ice, as it'll start cracking under your feet...
blocks.translated_text: 在 26.4 Snapshot 4 中，我们推出了一种全新的方块——脆冰（Brittle Ice）！此外，现在播放器（Jukebox）可以通过在上方放置音乐光盘来使用播放列表，让舞会变得更加轻松。不过要注意，不要在脆冰上跳舞，否则它可能会在你脚下破碎……

blocks.source_text: Happy Dance Break!
New Features
Added Jukebox Playlists
blocks.translated_text: 添加了播放器播放列表功能

blocks.source_text: Added Brittle Ice
Jukebox Playlists
Place a single Chest, Trapped Chest, or any Copper Chest variant directly above a Jukebox to use its Music Discs as a playlist
blocks.translated_text: 将一个普通的箱子（Chest）、陷阱箱子（Trapped Chest）或任何铜质箱子（Copper Chest）直接放置在播放器上方，就可以使用其中的音乐光盘作为播放列表了。

blocks.source_text: Discs play in slot order, skipping empty slots and other non-music-disc items and looping back to the start
blocks.translated_text: 光盘会按顺序播放，跳过空的插槽和其他非音乐光盘物品，并循环播放到开头。

blocks.source_text: When a disc finishes, the Jukebox swaps it with the next disc in the chest
blocks.translated_text: 当一张光盘播放完毕时，播放器会自动更换为箱子中的下一张光盘。

blocks.source_text: If the chest has no Music Discs, the disc in the Jukebox plays again
blocks.translated_text: 如果箱子中没有音乐 Disc，唱片机中的乐盘会再次播放

blocks.source_text: Ejecting the current disc skips to the next available disc
blocks.translated_text: 弹出当前乐盘后，游戏会跳转到下一张可用的乐盘

blocks.source_text: Brittle Ice
Brittle Ice is a new block that can be found in Ice Caves
blocks.translated_text: 脆弱冰块是一种新的方块，可以在冰洞中找到

blocks.source_text: Once a player or mob steps on it, it will start to crack and eventually break
blocks.translated_text: 一旦玩家或怪物踩在上面，它就会开始裂开，最终破碎

blocks.source_text: The Frostbite mob can walk on Brittle Ice without breaking it
blocks.translated_text: 霜冻兽（Frostbite mob）可以踩在脆弱冰块上而不会将其破坏

blocks.source_text: Brittle Ice only generates naturally in Ice Caves as part of the crevasse feature
blocks.translated_text: 脆弱冰块只会自然生成在冰洞中，作为冰裂隙特征的一部分

blocks.source_text: It is obtainable with Silk Touch
blocks.translated_text: 可以使用“丝质触觉”（Silk Touch）来获取脆弱冰块

blocks.source_text: It can also be created by water flowing onto a Blue Ice block
blocks.translated_text: 水流到蓝色冰块（Blue Ice block）上时也可以生成脆弱冰块

blocks.source_text: Any water block that borders the Blue Ice block horizontally will turn into Brittle Ice
blocks.translated_text: 与蓝色冰块水平相邻的任何水块都会变成脆弱冰块

blocks.source_text: Changes
Minor Tweaks to Blocks, Items and Entities
blocks.translated_text: 对方块、物品和实体的小幅调整

blocks.source_text: Frosted Ice now emits a vibration event when changing state
blocks.translated_text: 结霜冰在状态改变时现在会发出振动事件

blocks.source_text: Ice, Frosted Ice, and Brittle Ice will no longer show their inside block faces when placed next to each other
blocks.translated_text: 冰、结霜冰和脆冰在相邻放置时将不再显示其内部块面

blocks.source_text: Zombies, Drowned, and Husks are now immune to freezing and will not take damage from the Freezing effect
blocks.translated_text: 僵尸、溺亡者和尸壳现在对冻结具有免疫性，不会受到冻结效果的伤害

blocks.source_text: Drowned now turn into a Zombie before converting into a Frostbite when they are in Powder Snow
blocks.translated_text: 溺亡者在转化为霜冻伤害之前会先变成僵尸

blocks.source_text: Sounds
Added custom sounds for Ice, Packed Ice, Blue Ice and Frosted Ice blocks
blocks.translated_text: 为冰块、压实的冰块、蓝冰和结霜冰添加了自定义音效

blocks.source_text: Renamed minecraft:amethyst block sound set to minecraft:amethyst_block to better match sound event names
blocks.translated_text: 将 `minecraft:amethyst_block` 的音效集名称更改为 `minecraft:amethyst_block`，以更好地匹配音效事件名称

blocks.source_text: Technical Changes
The Data Pack version is now 124.0
The Resource Pack version is now 100.1
Network Protocol
The server now more consistently disconnects clients when a packet they sent causes an error
blocks.translated_text: 当客户端发送的数据包导致错误时，服务器现在会更一致地断开与该客户端的连接

blocks.source_text: Data Pack Version 124.0
Sound events
Removed sound events:
minecraft:intentionally_empty
Sulfur Cube Archetypes
Fields hit_sound and push_sound in sound_settings structure are now optional
Chicken Sound Variants
Fields ambient_sound , hurt_sound , death_sound , step_sound in adult_sounds and baby_sounds structures are now optional
blocks.translated_text: 在“成人声音”和“幼年声音”结构中，田野的环境音、受伤音、死亡音以及脚步音现在是可选的

blocks.source_text: Cow Sound Variants
Fields ambient_sound , hurt_sound , death_sound , step_sound are now optional
blocks.translated_text: 在“成人声音”和“幼年声音”结构中，田野的环境音、受伤音、死亡音以及脚步音现在是可选的

blocks.source_text: Cat Sound Variants

Fields ambient_sound , stray_ambient_sound , hiss_sound , hurt_sound , death_sound , eat_sound , beg_for_food_sound , purr_sound , purreow_sound in adult_sounds and baby_sounds structures are now optional
blocks.translated_text: 在“成人声音”和“幼年声音”结构中，田野的环境音、流浪环境音、嘶嘶声、受伤音、死亡音、进食声、乞食声、咕噜声以及“purreow”声现在是可选的

blocks.source_text: Pig Sound Variants
Fields ambient_sound , hurt_sound , death_sound , step_sound , eat_sound in adult_sounds and baby_sounds structures are now optional
blocks.translated_text: 在“成人声音”和“幼年声音”结构中，田野的环境音、受伤音、死亡音、脚步音以及进食声现在是可选的

blocks.source_text: Wolf Sound Variants
Fields ambient_sound , hurt_sound , death_sound , step_sound , growl_sound , pant_sound , whine_sound in adult_sounds and baby_sounds structures are now optional
blocks.translated_text: 在成体声音（adult_sounds）和幼年声音（baby_sounds）结构中，field的环境音（ambient_sound）、受伤音（hurt_sound）、死亡音（death_sound）、脚步声（step_sound）、低吼声（growl_sound）、喘息声（pant_sound）以及哀鸣声（whine_sound）现在都是可选的

blocks.source_text: Fluid States
Removed flowing_water and flowing_lava fluid types
blocks.translated_text: 移除了流动的水（flowing_water）和流动的岩浆（flowing_lava）这两种流体类型

blocks.source_text: Fluid types now have the following properties
blocks.translated_text: 流体类型现在具有以下属性

blocks.source_text: level : Integer; same as before, the level of fluid from 1 to 8
blocks.translated_text: level: 整数；与之前相同，液体的层级范围为1到8

blocks.source_text: source : Boolean; true for source blocks, false otherwise
blocks.translated_text: source: 布尔值；如果是源块则为true，否则为false

blocks.source_text: Predicates
Block Predicates
Updated
matching_fluids
Added a state field to match state properties
blocks.translated_text: 添加了一个状态字段，以便与状态属性进行匹配

blocks.source_text: Format:
state : A map of name-value properties to be matched against the fluid state properties
blocks.translated_text: state：一个名称-值属性的映射，用于与流体的状态属性进行匹配

blocks.source_text: Value can be integer, boolean or string or object with optional min and max properties
blocks.translated_text: 值可以是整数、布尔值、字符串或对象，并可设置最小值和最大值属性

blocks.source_text: Enchantments
Changed minecraft:explode Enchantment Effect
Fields small_particle , large_particle and sound are now optional
World Generation
Features
Added
crevasse
Feature Type

Carves a winding, tapered crevasse into exposed terrain. The crevasse follows the terrain surface, extends in opposite directions from its placement position and requires a minimum connected footprint before carving.
blocks.translated_text: 在裸露的地形上雕刻出一条蜿蜒、逐渐变窄的裂缝。裂缝沿着地形表面延伸，从放置位置向相反方向生长，并且雕刻前需要最小连贯的占地范围。」

blocks.source_text: Format: object with fields:
max_width - integer (between 2 and 8), maximum cross-section width in blocks
blocks.translated_text: max_width - 整数（2到8之间），裂缝的最大横截面积（以方块为单位）

blocks.source_text: max_length - integer (between 4 and 16), maximum end-to-end length in blocks
blocks.translated_text: max_length - 整数（4到16之间），裂缝的最大端到端长度（以方块为单位）

blocks.source_text: min_footprint - integer (between 1 and 32), minimum connected horizontal footprint required before carving
blocks.translated_text: min_footprint - 整数（1到32之间），雕刻前所需的最小水平连贯占地范围

blocks.source_text: cursor_surface_search_range - positive integer, maximum amount of blocks the cursor will scan downwards to find its next position
blocks.translated_text: cursor_surface_search_range - 正整数，光标向下扫描的最大方块数，以寻找下一个位置

blocks.source_text: column_surface_search_range - positive integer, maximum amount of blocks each carving will scan downwards to find a carvable surface
twistiness - float (between 0.0 and 16.0), amount of horizontal curvature
tapering - float (between 0.0 and 1.0), amount of tapering applied on each step of growing the crevasse
turn_factor - float (between 0.0 and 1.0), intensity of rotation applied on each step of growing the crevasse
carve_depth - int provider, carve depth below the origin terrain surface
fill_depth - int provider, fill depth below the origin terrain surface
surface_block - Block state provider, block placed over the crevasse opening
fill_block - Block state provider, block placed at or below the selected fill depth
carvable_blocks - Block predicate, which blocks the crevasse is allowed to remove
blocks.translated_text: 可挖掘的方块（carvable_blocks）——用于指定哪些带有裂缝的方块可以被移除

blocks.source_text: acceptable_barrier - Block predicate, which pre-existing blocks to accept as part of a barrier
blocks.translated_text: 可接受的屏障方块（acceptable_barrier）——用于指定哪些已存在的方块可以作为屏障的一部分

blocks.source_text: Tags
Block Tags
Added block tag #jukebox_containers to describe all blocks usable by a Jukebox as a source for music disc playlists
blocks.translated_text: 新增了 #jukebox_containers 方块标签，用于描述所有可以被 Jukebox 用作音乐唱片播放列表来源的方块

blocks.source_text: Added block tag #face_occluding_ice_blocks to describe all ice blocks that should enable face culling when placed next to each other
blocks.translated_text: 新增了 #face_occluding_ice_blocks 方块标签，用于描述所有在相互堆叠时能够实现表面剔除（face culling）的冰块

blocks.source_text: Entity Type Tags
blocks.translated_text: 实体类型标签（Entity Type Tags）

blocks.source_text: Added the entity type tag #does_not_break_brittle_ice for mobs that do not break Brittle Ice blocks when stepping on them
blocks.translated_text: 新增了 #does_not_break_brittle_ice 实体类型标签，用于标识那些踩在脆弱冰块上时不会破坏它的生物

With 26.4 Snapshot 4, we're breaking out a cool new block, introducing Brittle Ice! And Jukeboxes can now keep the music going with playlists by putting your music discs in a chest above them, making dance parties much easier. Just be careful not to dance on the Brittle Ice, as it'll start cracking under your feet...

Happy Dance Break!

New Features

Added Jukebox Playlists

Added Brittle Ice

Jukebox Playlists

Place a single Chest, Trapped Chest, or any Copper Chest variant directly above a Jukebox to use its Music Discs as a playlist

Discs play in slot order, skipping empty slots and other non-music-disc items and looping back to the start

When a disc finishes, the Jukebox swaps it with the next disc in the chest

If the chest has no Music Discs, the disc in the Jukebox plays again

Ejecting the current disc skips to the next available disc

Brittle Ice

Brittle Ice is a new block that can be found in Ice Caves

Once a player or mob steps on it, it will start to crack and eventually break

The Frostbite mob can walk on Brittle Ice without breaking it

Brittle Ice only generates naturally in Ice Caves as part of the crevasse feature

It is obtainable with Silk Touch

It can also be created by water flowing onto a Blue Ice block

Any water block that borders the Blue Ice block horizontally will turn into Brittle Ice

Changes

Minor Tweaks to Blocks, Items and Entities

Frosted Ice now emits a vibration event when changing state

Ice, Frosted Ice, and Brittle Ice will no longer show their inside block faces when placed next to each other

Zombies, Drowned, and Husks are now immune to freezing and will not take damage from the Freezing effect

Drowned now turn into a Zombie before converting into a Frostbite when they are in Powder Snow

Sounds

Added custom sounds for Ice, Packed Ice, Blue Ice and Frosted Ice blocks

Renamed minecraft:amethyst block sound set to minecraft:amethyst_block to better match sound event names

Technical Changes

The Data Pack version is now 124.0

The Resource Pack version is now 100.1

Network Protocol

The server now more consistently disconnects clients when a packet they sent causes an error

Data Pack Version 124.0

Sound events

Removed sound events:

minecraft:intentionally_empty

Sulfur Cube Archetypes

Fields hit_sound and push_sound in sound_settings structure are now optional

Chicken Sound Variants

Fields ambient_sound , hurt_sound , death_sound , step_sound in adult_sounds and baby_sounds structures are now optional

Cow Sound Variants

Fields ambient_sound , hurt_sound , death_sound , step_sound are now optional

Cat Sound Variants

Fields ambient_sound , stray_ambient_sound , hiss_sound , hurt_sound , death_sound , eat_sound , beg_for_food_sound , purr_sound , purreow_sound in adult_sounds and baby_sounds structures are now optional

Pig Sound Variants

Fields ambient_sound , hurt_sound , death_sound , step_sound , eat_sound in adult_sounds and baby_sounds structures are now optional

Wolf Sound Variants

Fields ambient_sound , hurt_sound , death_sound , step_sound , growl_sound , pant_sound , whine_sound in adult_sounds and baby_sounds structures are now optional

Fluid States

Removed flowing_water and flowing_lava fluid types

Fluid types now have the following properties

level : Integer; same as before, the level of fluid from 1 to 8

source : Boolean; true for source blocks, false otherwise

Predicates

Block Predicates

Updated

matching_fluids

Added a state field to match state properties

Format:

state : A map of name-value properties to be matched against the fluid state properties

Value can be integer, boolean or string or object with optional min and max properties

Enchantments

Changed minecraft:explode Enchantment Effect

Fields small_particle , large_particle and sound are now optional

World Generation

Features

Added

crevasse

Feature Type

Carves a winding, tapered crevasse into exposed terrain. The crevasse follows the terrain surface, extends in opposite directions from its placement position and requires a minimum connected footprint before carving.

Format: object with fields:

max_width - integer (between 2 and 8), maximum cross-section width in blocks

max_length - integer (between 4 and 16), maximum end-to-end length in blocks

min_footprint - integer (between 1 and 32), minimum connected horizontal footprint required before carving

cursor_surface_search_range - positive integer, maximum amount of blocks the cursor will scan downwards to find its next position

column_surface_search_range - positive integer, maximum amount of blocks each carving will scan downwards to find a carvable surface

twistiness - float (between 0.0 and 16.0), amount of horizontal curvature

tapering - float (between 0.0 and 1.0), amount of tapering applied on each step of growing the crevasse

turn_factor - float (between 0.0 and 1.0), intensity of rotation applied on each step of growing the crevasse

carve_depth - int provider, carve depth below the origin terrain surface

fill_depth - int provider, fill depth below the origin terrain surface

surface_block - Block state provider, block placed over the crevasse opening

fill_block - Block state provider, block placed at or below the selected fill depth

carvable_blocks - Block predicate, which blocks the crevasse is allowed to remove

acceptable_barrier - Block predicate, which pre-existing blocks to accept as part of a barrier

Tags

Block Tags

Added block tag #jukebox_containers to describe all blocks usable by a Jukebox as a source for music disc playlists

Added block tag #face_occluding_ice_blocks to describe all ice blocks that should enable face culling when placed next to each other

Entity Type Tags

Added the entity type tag #does_not_break_brittle_ice for mobs that do not break Brittle Ice blocks when stepping on them

Resource Pack Version 100.1

Block Sprites

Updated the following Block textures:

block/jukebox_side.png

block/jukebox_top.png

Added new Block textures:

block/brittle_ice_0.png

block/brittle_ice_1.png

block/brittle_ice_2.png

block/brittle_ice_3.png

block/jukebox_bottom.png

Sounds

Added new sound events:

block.blue_ice.break

block.blue_ice.fall

block.blue_ice.hit

block.blue_ice.place

block.blue_ice.step

block.brittle_ice.break

block.brittle_ice.fall

block.brittle_ice.hit

block.brittle_ice.place

block.brittle_ice.step

block.brittle_ice.crack

block.frosted_ice.break

block.frosted_ice.fall

block.frosted_ice.hit

block.frosted_ice.place

block.frosted_ice.step

block.ice.ambient

block.packed_ice.break

block.packed_ice.fall

block.packed_ice.hit

block.packed_ice.place

block.packed_ice.step

在 26.4 Snapshot 4 中，我们推出了一种全新的方块——脆冰（Brittle Ice）！此外，现在播放器（Jukebox）可以通过在上方放置音乐光盘来使用播放列表，让舞会变得更加轻松。不过要注意，不要在脆冰上跳舞，否则它可能会在你脚下破碎……

美好的舞会时光！

新增功能

添加了播放器播放列表功能

新增了脆冰方块

播放器播放列表功能

将一个普通的箱子（Chest）、陷阱箱子（Trapped Chest）或任何铜质箱子（Copper Chest）直接放置在播放器上方，就可以使用其中的音乐光盘作为播放列表了。

光盘会按顺序播放，跳过空的插槽和其他非音乐光盘物品，并循环播放到开头。

当一张光盘播放完毕时，播放器会自动更换为箱子中的下一张光盘。

如果箱子中没有音乐 Disc，唱片机中的乐盘会再次播放

弹出当前乐盘后，游戏会跳转到下一张可用的乐盘

脆弱冰块（Brittle Ice）

脆弱冰块是一种新的方块，可以在冰洞中找到

一旦玩家或怪物踩在上面，它就会开始裂开，最终破碎

霜冻兽（Frostbite mob）可以踩在脆弱冰块上而不会将其破坏

脆弱冰块只会自然生成在冰洞中，作为冰裂隙特征的一部分

可以使用“丝质触觉”（Silk Touch）来获取脆弱冰块

水流到蓝色冰块（Blue Ice block）上时也可以生成脆弱冰块

与蓝色冰块水平相邻的任何水块都会变成脆弱冰块

更改

对方块、物品和实体的小幅调整

结霜冰在状态改变时现在会发出振动事件

冰、结霜冰和脆冰在相邻放置时将不再显示其内部块面

僵尸、溺亡者和尸壳现在对冻结具有免疫性，不会受到冻结效果的伤害

溺亡者在转化为霜冻伤害之前会先变成僵尸

音效

为冰块、压实的冰块、蓝冰和结霜冰添加了自定义音效

将 `minecraft:amethyst_block` 的音效集名称更改为 `minecraft:amethyst_block`，以更好地匹配音效事件名称

技术性更改

数据包的版本现在是124.0

资源包的版本现在是100.1

网络协议

当客户端发送的数据包导致错误时，服务器现在会更一致地断开与该客户端的连接

数据包版本124.0

音效事件

移除了音效事件

minecraft:intentionally_empty

硫方怪的构建类型

在sound_settings结构中，fields_hit_sound和push_sound现在是可选的

鸡的声音变体

在“成人声音”和“幼年声音”结构中，田野的环境音、受伤音、死亡音以及脚步音现在是可选的

牛的声音变体

在“成人声音”和“幼年声音”结构中，田野的环境音、受伤音、死亡音以及脚步音现在是可选的

猫的声音变体

在“成人声音”和“幼年声音”结构中，田野的环境音、流浪环境音、嘶嘶声、受伤音、死亡音、进食声、乞食声、咕噜声以及“purreow”声现在是可选的

猪的声音变体

在“成人声音”和“幼年声音”结构中，田野的环境音、受伤音、死亡音、脚步音以及进食声现在是可选的

狼的声音变体

在成体声音（adult_sounds）和幼年声音（baby_sounds）结构中，field的环境音（ambient_sound）、受伤音（hurt_sound）、死亡音（death_sound）、脚步声（step_sound）、低吼声（growl_sound）、喘息声（pant_sound）以及哀鸣声（whine_sound）现在都是可选的

流体状态（Fluid States）

移除了流动的水（flowing_water）和流动的岩浆（flowing_lava）这两种流体类型

流体类型现在具有以下属性

level: 整数；与之前相同，液体的层级范围为1到8

source: 布尔值；如果是源块则为true，否则为false

谓词（Predicates）

方块谓词（Block Predicates）

已更新（Updated）

匹配流体（matching_fluids）

添加了一个状态字段，以便与状态属性进行匹配

格式：

state：一个名称-值属性的映射，用于与流体的状态属性进行匹配

值可以是整数、布尔值、字符串或对象，并可设置最小值和最大值属性

附魔

修改了minecraft:explode附魔效果

smallParticle、largeParticle和sound字段现在是可选的

世界生成

特性

已添加

裂缝

功能类型

在裸露的地形上雕刻出一条蜿蜒、逐渐变窄的裂缝。裂缝沿着地形表面延伸，从放置位置向相反方向生长，并且雕刻前需要最小连贯的占地范围。」

格式：包含字段的对象。

max_width - 整数（2到8之间），裂缝的最大横截面积（以方块为单位）

max_length - 整数（4到16之间），裂缝的最大端到端长度（以方块为单位）

min_footprint - 整数（1到32之间），雕刻前所需的最小水平连贯占地范围

cursor_surface_search_range - 正整数，光标向下扫描的最大方块数，以寻找下一个位置

column_surface_search_range

twistiness

tapering

turn_factor

carve_depth

fill_depth

surface_block

fill_block

可挖掘的方块（carvable_blocks）——用于指定哪些带有裂缝的方块可以被移除

可接受的屏障方块（acceptable_barrier）——用于指定哪些已存在的方块可以作为屏障的一部分

标签（Tags）

方块标签（Block Tags）

新增了 #jukebox_containers 方块标签，用于描述所有可以被 Jukebox 用作音乐唱片播放列表来源的方块

新增了 #face_occluding_ice_blocks 方块标签，用于描述所有在相互堆叠时能够实现表面剔除（face culling）的冰块

实体类型标签（Entity Type Tags）

新增了 #does_not_break_brittle_ice 实体类型标签，用于标识那些踩在脆弱冰块上时不会破坏它的生物

资源包版本 100.1

方块精灵（Block Sprites）

更新了以下块纹理：

block/jukebox_side.png

block/jukebox_top.png

添加了新的块纹理：

block/brittle_ice_0.png

block/brittle_ice_1.png

block/brittle_ice_2.png

block/brittle_ice_3.png

block/jukebox_bottom.png

声音

添加了新的音效事件：

蓝色冰块被破坏（block.blue_ice_break）

蓝色冰块掉落（block.blue_ice.fall）

蓝色冰块被击中（block.blue_ice_hit）

放置蓝色冰块（block.blue_ice.place）

在蓝色冰块上行走（block.blue_ice.step）

脆弱冰块被破坏（block.brittle_ice_break）

脆弱冰块掉落（block.brittle_ice.fall）

脆弱冰块被击中（block.brittle_ice_hit）

放置脆弱冰块（block.brittle_ice.place）

脆冰台阶

脆冰裂缝

冰霜冰块破碎

冰霜冰块掉落

冰霜冰块被击中

放置冰霜冰块

冰霜冰块台阶

普通冰块（环境용）

压实的冰块破碎

压实的冰块掉落

block.packed_ice_hit

block.packed_ice.place

block.packed_ice.step

修复了26.4快照4中的漏洞

[MC-80827](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-80827) - 宠物统计数据缺少宠物名称和描述之间的空格

[MC-148455](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-148455) - 在某些情况下，发放具有特殊行为的物品时只播放物品的使用音效

[MC-149032](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-149032) - 点击切石机选择界面的非按钮区域时会发出点击音效

[MC-163196] - 一些可以放置在粘液块旁边的方块不能放置在蜂蜜块旁边

[MC-251040] - 有些可以放置在粘液块上的方块无法放置在蜂蜜块上

[MC-251041] - 有些可以放置在粘液块底部的方块无法放置在蜂蜜块底部

[MC-275975](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-275975) - ‘Unknown element name’ 编码错误中缺少一个空格
